briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 push multi-agent frontiers amid escalating compute race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released 9 major models this month as funding hit $11.8B quarterly. Multi-agent systems dominate development priorities while safety gaps widen.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI shipped o4 with advanced reasoning; xAI launched Grok-4; DeepSeek-R2 and Anthropic Claude 4.1 followed. Meta's Llama 4.5 open weights sparked rapid fine-tuning activity on Hugging Face.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp accelerates with TSMC 2nm orders; Google and Microsoft announced new 100k H100 clusters in Texas and Arizona. Energy constraints now limit training runs beyond 10^27 FLOPs.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first company to reach 10^28 FLOPs training runs trigger an immediate regulatory intervention or accelerate open-source countermeasures?
